name: hao-encoder-edge
description: Boundary conditions: scores at exact thresholds (0.75 → THIEU_DUONG exclusive upper, 0.10 → THIEU_DUONG inclusive, -0.75 → THIEU_AM exclusive lower)
notes: Scores at threshold boundaries. 0.75 is NOT > 0.75 so THIEU_DUONG. 0.10 >= 0.10 so THIEU_DUONG. -0.75 is NOT < -0.75 so THIEU_AM. 0.76 > 0.75 so LAO_DUONG. -0.76 < -0.75 so LAO_AM.
